disposition_reason: Table 2 prints 17 elements, including arsenic, cadmium, lead and mercury, for each of 31 edible insect products bought online in December 2021; Tables 3-4 give summary and regional statistics.

study.design: market survey of 13 edible insects and 18 insect-based foods bought from one e-commerce platform
study.origin: as labeled: UAE, Thailand, UK, Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Netherlands, Belgium, Finland, Germany
study.market: one online e-commerce platform (country not stated)
study.method: oven-drying 60 °C, microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; ICP-MS (Agilent 7900) with Ge, Rh, Ir, Sc internal standards
study.lod_text: not stated; censored cells printed as '<' values (e.g. As <0.05, Cd <0.03 ppm)
study.qa: ISO 9001 certified service laboratory; no CRM or recovery reported
